author: Arbitra
rationale: Discovery reads beyond its unit: every unit carries an index of the whole repository, its tools read any file of the snapshot within a byte budget a call, it reads callers, callees and the other side of a boundary before concluding, and a finding may cite the lines it read there. Only 8 of nextra's 97 discovery calls used a tool, 52 limitations said a caller was not supplied, and a client-server gap was missed (docs/research.md, section 12).
compatibilityNotes: a run pinned at 1.0.0 cannot resume its discovery on a build of this version
